phases.goal: Build N1 core vocabulary and grammar while establishing daily reading habit.
rules: 20 genuinely new words per day unless review overload requires reduction
2 N1 grammar points per day with one confirmation question each
vocabulary questions emphasize reading, contextual usage, synonym/usage discrimination

phases.goal: Finish most new vocabulary/grammar coverage and increase mixed-question difficulty.
rules: continue new words until cumulative unique target is reached
increase mixed vocabulary and grammar traps
reading passages become longer and inference questions increase

phases.goal: Shift from coverage to retention and accuracy.
rules: new words only for uncovered curriculum gaps
prioritize unresolved wrong answers and uncertain words
run mixed grammar sets rather than isolated patterns
at least two long-reading days per week

phases.goal: Practice exam-like mixed sets under time pressure.
rules: focus on speed, distractor elimination, and reading structure
rotate weak vocabulary, grammar, and reading types
use recent wrong-answer frequency to select daily content
keep daily workload stable rather than cramming

must_exclude: all words already present in data/jlpt/used_words.json
all words already introduced in previous daily_words files

question_generation_rules.grammar_each_point: explanation + example + one multiple-choice confirmation question
question_generation_rules.wrong_answer_priority: unresolved wrong answers are inserted before optional new drill questions
